claim: “The OU leads international research into the Martian-like volcanic history of Venus”, plus atmospheric models of Venus’s evolution.

suggestion.to: The Open University is helping to prepare ESA's EnVision mission to Venus. With a £2.3 million ESA grant, an OU team leads the testing and characterisation of the detectors in the VenSpec-U ultraviolet spectrometer, which will study the sulphur chemistry of Venus's clouds, and takes part in science preparations for the mission.
